description: A locked field an invariant reads, given a call of a `fn` that reads a cell (`fn dbl(x) -> int { return x * @k; }`, `<w b=(dbl(2))/>`): E-CONTRACT-003 (the value tracks `@k`; PERMANENT).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-derived-split: "a field that tracks a cell or a live use-site value stays refused, PERMANENT, E-CONTRACT-003 (an @ read by another route)" — a `fn` may read outer bindings (§48.5.3), so a call of one tracks what it reads.
